name: replay-theater
description: Replay Theater: step through the file edits Claude made, one diff at a time. Any of the last turns, with real line numbers, side by side or unified, a file list, a filter, a patch to copy, and folded diffs for minified and generated files.

keep_turns.title: Turns kept
keep_turns.description: How many of the latest turns that changed files can be replayed (1 to 50). They live in memory for this session only.

fold_over_lines.title: Fold diffs longer than (lines)
fold_over_lines.description: A diff that changes more lines than this starts folded, and so does a minified or generated file. Press Expand to open it. 0 never folds on size.

default_view.title: Diff layout
default_view.description: unified: one column, with syntax colours. split: old and new side by side. The s key and /replay split change it for the session.

show_hint.title: Show the hint above the prompt
show_hint.description: After a turn that changed files, show "Replay: N edits (press r)" above the prompt. Turn off to open the replay only with /replay.
